groups.name: Centered narrow max-width container
groups.definition: Is the main content constrained to a centered, fixed or max-width container with generous side margins (narrower than full viewport)?

groups.name: Uses CSS grid with flexbox
groups.definition: Is the page layout built with CSS grid and/or flexbox containers?

groups.name: Full-bleed hero image with overlaid text
groups.definition: Is the hero a full-width edge-to-edge image (often darkened) with headline text overlaid on it?

groups.name: Split hero or section with image and text
groups.definition: Does a hero or section use a two-column split pairing an image with a text panel or text column?

groups.name: Equal card grid
groups.definition: Are items shown as a grid or row of equal-size cards (bordered or panelled) in multiple columns?

groups.name: Single-column stacked full-width sections
groups.definition: Is the page a single column of full-width stacked sections or alternating colored bands without a sidebar?

groups.name: Simple logo-left nav-right header
groups.definition: Is the header a single compact bar with a logo on the left and navigation links on the right?

groups.name: Multi-column dark footer
groups.definition: Is the footer a dark band with multiple columns of links and a divider above small copyright text?

groups.name: Compact short page with tight spacing
groups.definition: Is the page compact and short with tight vertical rhythm and no large empty gaps?

groups.name: Hero with CTA at far right
groups.definition: Does the hero place its call-to-action or secondary element at the far right with empty space between?

groups.name: Main content with sidebar
groups.definition: Is there a wide main column with a narrow sidebar beside it?

groups.name: Search form band below hero
groups.definition: Is there a distinct search form band attached to the bottom of the hero?

groups.name: Left-aligned editorial or section heading layout
groups.definition: Are section headings left-aligned on plain backgrounds, or editorial text in a narrow left-aligned column?

groups.name: Feature sections use full-bleed background images with a dar
groups.definition: Feature sections use full-bleed background images with a dark overlay and text overlaid on the left.

groups.name: Hero shows several banners side by side as a cropped multi-p
groups.definition: Hero shows several banners side by side as a cropped multi-panel strip rather than a slider.
